lemmas: chercher une aiguille dans une botte de foin

stories.title: Au restaurant
stories.summary: Julie and Hugo have dinner in a small restaurant. The waiter is kind, but one dish is not available.

stories.title: À la boulangerie
stories.summary: Before work, Claire stops at the bakery for bread and pastries. The baker is very friendly.

stories.title: Changer de vie
stories.summary: Camille, a graphic designer in Paris, dreams of opening a small bookshop in a village. She weighs the risks, talks to her sister and visits the place before making her decision.

stories.title: Le chien perdu
stories.summary: Clara finds a lost brown dog in the park. With her father, she tries everything to find its owner.

stories.title: Le dernier train
stories.summary: After two exhausting days of meetings in Bordeaux, Hélène misses the last train home to La Rochelle by one minute. Alone in the nearly empty station, she is joined on her bench by an old man with a thermos who seems to be waiting for a train that does not exist.

stories.title: Ana en Madrid
stories.summary: Ana arrives in Madrid with a heavy suitcase and climbs the stairs to her new flat. On the way, someone opens a door.

stories.title: El autobús
stories.summary: Elena is in a hurry to get to work on Monday morning. Then she notices the bus is going the wrong way.

stories.title: El cumpleaños
stories.summary: It is Elena's birthday, but nobody seems to remember it. Her husband invites her to dinner.

stories.title: El nuevo compañero
stories.summary: A shy new colleague joins the office and barely speaks. Over one week, the narrator discovers what he is really good at.

stories.title: El perro de Luis
stories.summary: Luis takes his little dog Toby to the park to play ball. Then Toby sees a cat and runs off.

stories.title: En el mercado
stories.summary: Mateo goes to the Saturday market with his grandmother and carries a very big bag. Then something rolls away down the street.

stories.title: En la tienda de ropa
stories.summary: It is cold, so Lucía goes into a shop to buy a new jacket. The first one is not quite right.

stories.title: La cafetería
stories.summary: It is eight in the morning in a small cafe, and the waitress is in a hurry. Two customers get the wrong orders.

stories.title: La carta de mi abuelo
stories.summary: While clearing out her late grandfather's house, a woman finds an unsent letter hidden in a book of poems. She sets out to find the person it was written for.

stories.title: La receta de la abuela
stories.summary: Sara's grandmother teaches her to make a Spanish potato omelette. The lesson does not go quite to plan.

stories.title: Mi casa
stories.summary: A proud new home-owner shows their friend Marta around the house, room by room. Then something important goes missing.

stories.title: Mi día
stories.summary: Pablo, a student, tells us about his ordinary day. In class, something funny happens with his phone.

stories.title: Mi familia
stories.summary: Lucía introduces her family and her two pets. One Saturday, her dad comes home with a moving box.

stories.title: Un día de lluvia
stories.summary: Julia leaves home with her red umbrella on a rainy morning. By lunchtime she is standing in the rain without it.

stories.title: Un día en la playa
stories.summary: A family spends a hot, sunny day at the beach. Then a strong wind takes Ana's yellow hat.

stories.title: Un pueblo en la montaña
stories.summary: An overworked office employee from Madrid rents a house in a mountain village for a week, sure she will be bored. The slow rhythm of the place surprises her.

stories.title: Viaje a Sevilla
stories.summary: Lucas takes the train from Madrid to visit his friend Irene in Seville. Something distracts him on the way to meet her.

stories.title: Un été en Provence
stories.summary: On the metro, a woman smells lavender and remembers the summer she worked on a farm in Provence at nineteen, and the boy she met there.

stories.title: La fête surprise
stories.summary: Three friends prepare a surprise birthday party for Lucas. But he comes home early, and they must save the day.

stories.title: Une journée difficile
stories.summary: Antoine's Monday goes wrong from the very first minute: no alarm, a missed bus, rain and a forgotten wallet. Will anything go right?

stories.title: La lettre
stories.summary: Hélène finds an old unsent letter inside a second-hand book. She decides to find the friend it was meant for.

stories.title: La traversée
stories.summary: After thirty years in Montreal, Soazig takes the night boat back to the Breton island where she was born, to deal with her late father's house. On deck, an old islander recognises her and starts to remember.

stories.title: Léa arrive à Paris
stories.summary: Léa steps off the train in Paris with a big red suitcase. She is hungry, so she finds a café.

stories.title: Léa prend le métro
stories.summary: Léa buys a ticket, asks a kind lady for help, and takes the yellow line to a big park.

stories.title: Léa au marché
stories.summary: Léa visits a busy street market to buy fruit. The friendly seller has a very funny name.

stories.title: Léa téléphone à sa mère
stories.summary: In the evening, Léa phones her mother and tells her about her days in Paris. Her mother asks lots of simple questions.

stories.title: Ma famille
stories.summary: Ten-year-old Hugo introduces his family: his parents, his little sister and a cat. Then he asks who is the funniest.

stories.title: La maison de ma grand-mère
stories.summary: After their grandmother's death, a woman and her brother spend one last weekend sorting her house in an Auvergne village before it is put up for sale. Every drawer holds a memory, and not everything is easy to let go of.

stories.title: Max le chat
stories.summary: Max is a grey cat with green eyes who lives with Emma. One sunny morning he sees a little bird from the window and has a big plan.

stories.title: Max et le poisson rouge
stories.summary: Max the grey cat discovers a goldfish named Bulle in a bowl. He watches it and tries to touch it, until Emma arrives.

stories.title: Un métier d'avenir
stories.summary: Inès, twenty-two, must choose between the secure career her father recommends and her real passion, restoring old furniture. An old cabinetmaker offers her a trial week in his workshop.

stories.title: Mon appartement
stories.summary: A young man shows his small flat room by room, but he cannot find his keys anywhere.

stories.title: Un nouveau voisin
stories.summary: Inès meets her new neighbour Karim in the stairwell, surrounded by his moving boxes. She offers to help.

stories.title: Le parapluie jaune
stories.summary: On a rainy day in Lyon, Thomas gives his umbrella to an old lady on the bus. The next day, she has a surprise for him.

stories.title: Le photographe de Belleville
stories.summary: At dawn, an ageing street photographer walks the steep streets of Belleville with his young apprentice. She cannot understand why he never photographs faces, and she means to find out.

stories.title: Mon premier jour de travail
stories.summary: Sarah starts her first day in a small bookshop. She is nervous, and a customer asks for a book she cannot find.

stories.title: Le vieux vélo
stories.summary: Théo finds his grandfather's old bicycle in the garage. Together they clean it, repair it, and get ready for a first ride.

stories.title: Le vol au musée
stories.summary: Inspector Roche, who loves coffee and long walks, investigates the theft of a small painting from a little museum in Lyon. One odd detail on the floor tells him more than any witness.

stories.title: Un week-end à la mer
stories.summary: The Roux family drives to the sea for the weekend. The wind, a lost hat and a small crab make the day an adventure.
